items.h: Matt Gay misses field goal in Week 7
items.s: Matt Gay converted three of his four field goal attempts to finish with nine points in the Raiders' 35-21 loss to the Los Angeles Rams in Week 7. Gay has taken advantage of his opportunities to this point, recording six or more points in five of six contests. The kicker will look for more success against the Buffalo Bills in Week 8.

items.h: Makes three field-goals in loss
items.s: Gay converted all three of his field-goal attempts and all three extra-point tries during Las Vegas' loss to the Bills on Sunday. Gay had a strong outing despite the loss, as he was perfect kicking the ball, although all of his kicks came from close range, with his longest being 35 yards out. The 32-year-old has gotten off to a strong start this season, converting 14 of his 15 field-goal attempts and all 14 extra-point tries across his first six outings.

items.h: Matt Gay scores 12 points in loss Sunday
items.s: Matt Gay went 3-for-3 on his field-goal attempts and 3-for-3 on his extra-point attempts in Sunday's 33-30 loss to the Buffalo Bills. Gay did his job on Sunday, knocking down all six of his attempted kicks in Las Vegas' narrow loss to the Buffalo Bills. Fantasy managers should be happy with his performance and should continue to view him as a decent fantasy option at the position moving forward.

items.h: Misses first kick of 2026
items.s: Gay went 1-for-2 on field-goal attempts and converted both of his extra-point tries during the Raiders' 45-17 loss to the Patriots on Sunday. Gay entered Sunday's game having made all 10 of his previous field-goal tries, but his first attempt from late in the second quarter from 48 yards hit the left upright, and the Patriots' offense capitalized on the good field possession with a five-play touchdown drive. Gay connected on a 46-yard field goal midway through the third quarter, and the veteran kicker is now 11-for-12 on field-goal attempts and 11-for-11 on extra-point tries through the first five games of the regular season. Up next for the Raiders is a Week 6 home tilt Oct. 18 against…

items.h: Matt Gay accounts for five points in Week 5 loss
items.s: Matt Gay made 1-of-2 field goals and both of his extra points in the Raiders loss to the Patriots. Gay banged a 49-yard field goal attempt off the upright late in the second quarter, but was able to connect from 46-yards out in the third quarter. Gay and the Raiders will take on the Bills in Week 6.

items.h: Matt Gay makes four FGs in Week 4
items.s: Matt Gay made all four of his field-goal attempts and added one extra point in a 30-27 loss to the Chiefs in Week 4. Gay hit field goals from 32, 48, 44, and 48 yards out in the close loss. The veteran has now made all 10 of his field goals in 2026. He will take on the Patriots in Week 5.

items.h: Nails four field-goal tries
items.s: Gay went 4-for-4 on field-goal attempts and made his only extra-point try during Sunday's 30-27 loss to the Chiefs. Gay continued his perfect start to the year, converting a season-high four field-goals. The kicker made field goals from 32 and 48 yards in the second quarter and later added makes from 44 and 48 yards in the fourth quarter. Gay has now gone 10-for-10 on field-goal tries while converting all nine of his PATs over four contests this season.

items.h: Gay went 4-for-4 on field-goal attempts and made his only extra-point try during Sunday's 30-27 loss to the Chiefs.

The kicker made field goals from 32 and 48 yards in the second quarter and later added makes from 44 and 48 yards in the fourth quarter. Gay has now gone 10-for-10 on field-goal tries while converting all nine of his PATs over four contests this season.

items.h: Matt Gay connects on five kicks Sunday
items.s: Matt Gay made 3-of-3 field goal attempts and 2-of-2 extra point attempts on Sunday. Gay connected on field goals from 41, 37 and 25 yards out. He is 7-for-7 on field goal attempts through the first three games.

items.h: Perfect day in win
items.s: Gay made all three of his field-goal attempts and both extra-point tries in Sunday's 35-27 win over the Saints. The kicker hit field goals from 41, 37 and 25 yards out, respectively, helping the Raiders light up the scoreboard. Gay has yet to miss this season, and the 3-0 Raiders have scored at least 26 points in every game.

items.h: Gay made all three of his field-goal attempts and both extra-point tries in Sunday's 35-27 win over the Saints.
items.s: The kicker hit field goals from 41, 37 and 25 yards out, respectively, helping the Raiders light up the scoreboard. Gay has yet to miss this season, and the 3-0 Raiders have scored at least 26 points in every game.

items.h: Three PATs in win
items.s: Gay made his sole field-goal attempt and converted three PATs in Sunday's 26-14 win over the Chargers. Gay made a 59-yard field goal at the end of the first half of Sunday's game to break the Raiders' 7-7 tie with the Chargers. The kicker remains perfect through two weeks, 3-for-3 on field goals and 6-for-6 on PATs.

items.h: Gay made his sole field-goal attempt and converted three PATs in Sunday's 26-14 win over the Chargers.
items.s: Gay made a 59-yard field goal at the end of the first half of Sunday's game to break the Raiders' 7-7 tie with the Chargers. The kicker remains perfect through two weeks, sitting at 3-for-3 on field goals and 6-for-6 on PATs.

items.h: Gay converted both of his field-goal attempts and all three extra points in the Raiders' 27-13 win over the Dolphins on Sunday.
items.s: Gay signed with Las Vegas in the offseason and beat out Kansei Matsuzawa for the Raiders' kicking job over the summer. He's looking for a bounce-back season after struggling in 2025 with the Commanders and 49ers, converting a career-low 73.9 percent of his field-goal tries, including just four of nine from 50-plus yards. Gay's field goals were good from 47 and 30 yards against Miami on Sunday.

items.h: Gay converted four of five field-goal attempts in Thursday night's 18-12 preseason loss to the 49ers.
items.s: Gay made field goals from 37, 53, 45 and 48 yards while missing one from 54 yards. The veteran kicker had a strong overall showing, accounting for all 12 of the Raiders' points in the preseason finale. The 32-year-old appears ready for the mid-range challenges, but he once again may struggle from 50-plus yards, making just four of nine attempts during the 2025 season (44 percent).

items.h: Gay made his only field-goal attempt from 52 yards in Thursday's 22-20 preseason win over the Texans.
items.s: Gay outperformed rookie Kansei Matsuzawa in the Raiders' second preseason game, as Matsuzawa didn't attempt a field goal but converted only one of three PAT tries. Gay has been the favorite from the outset of Vegas' kicker competition thanks to the 32-year-old's edge in experience, and Thursday's results should help further tip the scales in his favor.

items.h: Gay worked as the first-team kicker at Friday's training camp practice and made all of his attempts, Sam Warren of the Athletic reports.
items.s: Gay rotated in ahead of Kansei Matsuzawa, the latter of whom had a 40-yard miss in Friday's practice but made the rest of his attempts. With 102 games of regular-season kicking experience under his belt, Gay looks like the early favorite in the competition against the undrafted rookie Matsuzawa.

items.h: Gay is set to compete with Kansei Matsuzawa for the Raiders' kicking role in training camp, Ryan McFadden of ESPN.com reports.
items.s: The Raiders moved on from Daniel Carlson after the 2025 season and subsequently brought in the veteran Gay and the rookie Matsuzawa. Gay converted 81 of 101 field-goal attempts over the previous three seasons, split between the Colts, 49ers and Commanders. Matsuzawa is coming off a stellar season at Hawaii, where he made 27 of 29 field-goal attempts in 2025.

items.h: Gay is set to sign with the Raiders, Tom Pelissero of NFL Network reports.
items.s: Gay began last season with Washington but was cut in mid-November after going 13-for-19 on field-goal tries. He then signed with San Francisco and went a perfect 8-for-8 on field-goal attempts, but he was just holding down the fort in the absence of Eddy Pineiro and was ultimately cut upon Pineiro's return. Gay's signing likely means that Daniel Carlson, who is an unrestricted free agent, won't return to Las Vegas after eight seasons with the franchise.

items.h: The 49ers released Gay from their practice squad Tuesday.
items.s: Gay stepped in as the 49ers' kicker for the team's last two games while Eddy Pineiro (hamstring) was sidelined and went a perfect 8-for-8 on kicks (four field goals, four extra points). The 49ers' decision to part ways with Gay signals that Pineiro is healthy coming out of the team's Week 14 bye and ready to handle kicking duties Sunday versus the Titans.

items.h: The 49ers reverted Gay to their practice squad Monday, per the NFL's transaction log.
items.s: With Eddy Pineiro missing the past two weeks due to a hamstring injury, Gay has stepped in and gone 4-for-4 on field goals as well as 4-for-4 on PATs. San Francisco is on bye Week 14 and Pineiro is trending toward active status when the team returns to action Week 15, so Gay's tenure as the club's kicker may have come to an end.

items.h: Gay converted both of his field-goal attempts and both extra-point tries in the 49ers' 26-8 win over the Browns on Sunday.
items.s: Elevated from the practice squad for the second straight week after he was cut by the Commanders following Week 11, Gay is now a perfect four-for-four on field goals and four-for-four on extra points across two games with San Francisco. It's unclear if Eddy Pineiro (hamstring) will be ready to return to kicking duties when the Niners come out of their Week 14 bye.

items.h: The 49ers elevated Gay from the practice squad to the active roster Saturday, and he will serve as the 49ers' starting kicker against the Browns on Sunday.
items.s: Gay will kick for the 49ers for a second consecutive week due to the absence of Eddy Pineiro (hamstring). Gay made both of his field-goal attempts and both of his extra-point tries during the 49ers' Week 12 win over the Panthers.

items.h: Gay reverted to the 49ers' practice squad Tuesday, per the NFL transaction log.
items.s: Gay made his 49ers' debut only one week after being waived by the Commanders. He made a pair of field goals and two extra-point attempts in Monday's win over the Panthers and will presumably retain kicking duties for Week 13 against the Browns should Eddy Pineiro (hamstring) remain sidelined.

items.h: Gay converted both of his field-goal tries and both of his point-after attempts in Monday's 20-9 Week 12 win over Carolina.
items.s: Gay played his first game with San Francisco after being elevated from the practice squad due to Eddy Pineiro dealing with a hamstring injury. Gay did his part to contribute to the 49ers' win, knocking in field goals from 47 and 29 yards out while making both his PATs. Pineiro is considered week-to-week, so Gay could serve as San Francisco's kicker again next Sunday in Cleveland.

items.h: San Francisco has elevated Gay from the practice squad to the active roster to start versus the Panthers on Monday,
items.s: Gay will handle placekicking duties for the 49ers on Monday Night Football with Eddy Pineiro (hamstring) ruled out and considered week-to-week. Across 10 regular-season appearances with Washington this year, Gay converted just 13 of 19 field-goal tries, but he was perfect on all 22 of his extra-point attempts. If Pineiro is forced to spend multiple games on the sideline, Gay could get an extended run in San Francisco, provided he's able to display consistency.

items.h: The 49ers signed Gay to the practice squad Wednesday.
items.s: Coach Kyle Shanahan revealed Monday that Eddy Pineiro was diagnosed with a Grade 1 hamstring strain following Sunday's win at Arizona and is considered "week-to-week," per David Lombardi of SFStandard.com. The 49ers subsequently tried out five kickers between Tuesday and Wednesday before deciding to roll the dice with Gay, who was waived by the Commanders on Monday. Gay thus will be elevated from the practice squad to handle kicking duties Monday against the Panthers if Pineiro sits out the contest.

items.h: Gay is signing with the 49ers, Tom Pelissero of NFL Network reports.
items.s: The Commanders waived Gay on Monday after he missed two field-goal attempts in Sunday's 16-13 loss to the Dolphins. He made just 13 of 19 attempts for Washington this season, but he was at least perfect on PATs, and he apparently impressed the 49ers during a workout this week. With Eddy Pineiro nursing a hamstring injury, Gay may end up kicking for San Francisco this Sunday against the Panthers.

items.h: The Commanders waived Gay on Monday.
items.s: Gay will head to waivers since the trade deadline has passed, but he's had a dreadful season in Washington after signing a one-year deal with the team over the offseason. Gay has converted just 13 of 19 field-goal attempts and all 22 extra-point tries. He missed a pair of field goals in the Commanders' 16-13 overtime loss to the Dolphins on Sunday.

items.h: Gay went 2-for-4 on field-goal attempts and made his lone extra-point try during the Commanders' 16-13 overtime loss to the Dolphins on Sunday.
items.s: Both of Gay's misses came from 51 and 56 yards in the second and fourth quarters, respectively, but they turned out to be crucial misses in what was a close affair in Madrid, Spain. It was the second time this season that the veteran kicker missed two field goals in a game, and he is now 4-for-9 on field-goal attempts from 50-plus yards. Gay is now 13-for-19 on field-goal attempts and 22-for-22 on extra-point tries through 10 regular-season games.

items.h: Gay made his lone field-goal attempt and his only extra-point try in Sunday's loss to the Lions.
items.s: Gay's field goal came from 44 yards out, and the veteran kicker has now made 11 of 15 field-goal attempts and all 21 of his extra-point tries through nine games this season. In a down season for the Washington offense, Gay has minimal fantasy value, especially while Jayden Daniels (elbow) is injured.

items.h: Gay did not attempt a field goal while making both of his extra-point tries in Sunday night's 38-14 loss to the Seahawks.
items.s: Gay was back in action in Week 9 after missing one contest with a back injury, going without a field-goal try for the second straight game in which he's started. The kicker has had an inconsistent campaign in terms of workload and production, and he has now gone 10-for-14 on field-goal attempts, including 4-for-7 from 50-plus yards, while making all 20 of his PATs over eight games this year.

items.h: Gay (back) doesn't have a designation for Sunday's contest against the Seahawks, John Keim of ESPN.com reports.
items.s: Gay didn't practice last Saturday due to a back injury and then was ruled out ahead of Monday's eventual loss at Kansas City. Matthew Wright filled in for Gay and connected on his only kick (a PAT), but the former reverted to the practice squad Tuesday and was promptly cut, signaling that Gay was set to return to action Week 9. After progressing from no activity Wednesday to limited Thursday and then full Friday, Gay has done just that and will resume placekicking duties for the Commanders on Sunday.

items.h: Gay (back) was limited at Thursday's practice.
items.s: Gay missed the final session of Week 8 prep due to a back injury and then was ruled out ahead of Monday's eventual loss at Kansas City. Matthew Wright stepped in for Gay and made his only kick (a PAT), but the latter's return to practice three days later is a sign of progress for the seventh-year pro. Gay's listing on Friday's practice report will reveal whether or not he has a chance to play Sunday versus the Seahawks.

items.h: Commanders coach Dan Quinn said Wednesday that Gay (back) will not practice, Nicki Jhabvala of The Washington Post reports.
items.s: Gay was a late scratch for Washington's loss to the Chiefs on Monday, which prompted the team to sign Matthew Wright to the practice squad and elevate him for game day. Wright did not attempt a field goal and made his only extra-point try during the loss to Kansas City, and he'll stand to be elevated again versus the Seahawks on Sunday if Gay isn't able to return to full health in time to play Week 9.

items.h: Gay (back) has been downgraded to out for Monday's game against the Chiefs.
items.s: Gay will miss Week 8 due to a lingering back injury, with Washington instead elevating Matthew Wright from the practice squad to handle placekicker duties. It remains to be seen whether Gay's injury could force him to miss any more time, but his next chance to take the field will come Week 9 at home against the Seahawks on Sunday, Nov. 2.

items.h: Gay didn't practice Saturday due to a back injury and is listed as questionable for Monday's game at Kansas City.
items.s: Gay was a late addition to the Commanders' Week 8 injury report, as he didn't have any practice limitations prior to Saturday. Washington currently doesn't roster another kicker, even on its practice squad, so the team would need to sign one before Monday's game as insurance in the event Gay isn't able to suit up.

items.h: Gay went 2-for-2 on extra-point tries in Sunday's 44-22 loss to the Cowboys.
items.s: The kicker did not get a chance to attempt a field goal. Gay has yet to miss an extra point this year, going 18-for-18, though he has missed four field goals (10-for-14).

items.h: Gay went 1-for-2 on field-goal attempts and made all three of his PATs in Monday night's 25-24 loss to the Bears.
items.s: Gay hit the left upright on a 50-yard field-goal try in the second quarter, missing his first kick since Week 3. The kicker later added a make from 53 yards to finish off the Commanders' first drive of the second half. Gay has gone 10-for-14 on field-goal attempts, including 4-for-7 from 50-plus yards, while making all 16 of his extra-point tries over six games this year.

items.h: Gay hit both field-goal attempts and all three extra-point tries in Sunday's 27-10 win over the Chargers.
items.s: The kicker's longest field-goal in the game was just 36 yards, but he was reliable and has been the last two weeks after missing three field goals total in Weeks 2 and 3. Gay has not yet missed an extra point, going 13-for-13, in 2025. With Jayden Daniels back under center for the Commanders, Gay should get plenty of scoring opportunities.

items.h: Gay went 4-for-4 on field-goal attempts and made his lone extra-point try during the Commanders' 34-27 loss to the Falcons.
items.s: Gay helped the Commanders keep pace with the Falcons when the offense stalled outside of the red zone, connecting on field goals from 43, 52, 41 and 42 yards in Sunday's loss. It was the fifth time in Gay's career that he made at least five field goals, and it was a nice bounce-back performance after he went 3-for-6 across Washington's prior two games.

items.h: Gay went 2-for-3 on field-goal attempts and made five PATs in Sunday's 41-24 win over the Raiders.
items.s: Gay missed a 37-yard field goal wide right in the first quarter, but he later rebounded with makes from 46 yards and 56 yards in the second quarter, the latter of which was as time expired in the first half. The kicker has now gone 3-for-6 on field-goal tries, while making all nine of his extra-point attempts over three games this season.

items.h: Gay made one of three field-goal attempts and connected on his only PAT try in Thursday's 27-18 loss to the Packers.
items.s: Gay made a 51-yard field-goal attempt but then missed from 58 and 52, continuing his struggles from 50-plus yards out after making only three of nine such kicks in 2024 with the Colts. Washington had a surprisingly tough time moving the ball Thursday, netting only 230 yards of total offense. Gay's lack of accuracy from distance coupled with modest offensive output from the Commanders isn't a formula for fantasy success.

items.h: Gay did not attempt a field goal and made a three of his extra-point tries in Sunday's 21-6 win over the Giants.
items.s: Gay signed with the Commanders in the offseason, taking over as the starting kicker in Washington after spending the last two seasons with the Colts. Gay had a rather uneventful debut with the team, but he'll have another shot at making a bigger impact in Thursday's matchup with the Packers in Green Bay.

items.h: Gay signed a one-year, $4.25 million contract with Washington on Tuesday, John Keim of ESPN.com reports.
items.s: Gay's deal is fully guaranteed and reportedly coincides with the release of veteran incumbent Zane Gonzalez. Across 16 regular-season appearances with Indianapolis in 2024, Gay converted 31 of 37 field-goal attempts (84 percent), with all six of his misses coming from 50-plus yards out. He also converted all 33 of his extra-point tries.

items.h: The Colts released Gay on Thursday.
items.s: Gay inked a four-year, $22.5 million deal with Indianapolis in 2023 and was reliable as a kicker from inside 50 in 2024, so his release comes as a surprise. The decision to move on from Gay is seemingly related to the fact that he missed six of his nine field-goal attempts from 50-plus yards out last year, recording an 80 percent conversion rate overall (31 of 37) across 16 regular-season appearances. The transaction leaves Spencer Shrader as the only kicker on the Colts' roster.

items.h: Gay connected on 31 of 37 field-goal attempts and all 33 extra-point tries across 16 regular-season games this season.
items.s: All six of Gay's misses came from 50 yards or longer. Gay, in his sixth season, made at least 80 percent of his field-goal tries for the fifth year in a row. He has also missed just one extra point in two seasons and 33 regular-season games with the Colts since signing a four-year, $22.5 million deal in 2023.

items.h: Gay went 2-for-3 on field-goal attempts and converted all three of his extra-point tries during the Colts' 45-33 loss to the Giants on Sunday.
items.s: Gay got the Colts on the board late in the first quarter with a 32-yard field goal, but he missed his next attempt from 54 yards out early in the second frame. He bounced back with a 29-yard chip shot later in the second quarter, and his next three kicks came on extra-point attempts. Gay is now 27-for-32 on field-goal attempts and 31-for-31 on extra-point tries through 15 regular-season games.

items.h: Gay went 1-for-2 on his field-goal attempts and made all five of his extra-point tries during the Colts' 38-30 win over the Titans on Sunday.
items.s: Gay entered Sunday's game with a questionable tag due to a neck injury, but he was cleared during pregame warmups. He connected on a 31-yard field goal late in the second quarter to give the Colts a 10-point lead, but his 55-yard field-goal attempt early in the fourth quarter that would've put Indianapolis up by 19 points sailed right. Gay had gone 10-for-10 on field-goal tries over the Colts' five games prior to Sunday's AFC South clash, and through 14 regular-season contests he's gone 25-for-29 on field-goal attempts and has made all 28 of his extra-point tries.

items.h: Gay, who had been listed as questionable with a neck injury, is listed as active for Sunday's game against the Titans.
items.s: After not practicing Wednesday and Thursday, Gay practiced fully Friday, setting the stage for the kicker to be available for Sunday's contest. In 13 games this season, Gay has recorded 95 points, while connecting on 24 of his 27 field-goal attempts and all 23 of his extra-point tries, a pace that puts him on the fantasy radar in deeper leagues ahead of the next wave of Week 16 action.

items.h: Gay (neck) is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Titans.
items.s: After logging a pair of DNPs on Wednesday and Thursday, Gay was able to practice fully Friday, suggesting he's looking good for Sunday. After a down 2023 season in which he made just 80.5 percent of his field-goal attempts, Gay has righted the ship again this season, making 24 of 27 field-goal attempts and all 23 of his extra-point tries. The Colts don't currently employ another kicker.

items.h: Gay (neck) did not participate in Thursday's practice.
items.s: Gay has now logged consecutive DNPs to start the week due to a neck injury he may have picked up during the Colts' Week 15 loss to the Broncos. If the Colts sign a placekicker to the practice squad, that would indicate that Gay is in jeopardy of being sidelined for Sunday's game against the Titans.
